requirements.title: Validate Tunisian identifiers
requirements.description: Validators for CIN, mobile, landline, RIB (mod 97), IBAN (ISO 7064), matricule fiscale, passport, license plate and postal code.
acceptance: Each validator accepts documented valid inputs and rejects malformed ones, as covered by tests/

requirements.title: Format Tunisian data
requirements.description: Formatters for phone, landline, IBAN, CIN and currency, including Arabic-Indic digit variants.
acceptance: Formatters produce documented outputs and return safe values for invalid input

requirements.title: Bilingual reference data
requirements.description: Immutable governorate, delegation, bank, landline-region and postal-range data with lookups; French and Arabic labels.
acceptance: 24 governorates and canonical delegations with stable IDs

requirements.title: Zero runtime dependencies, tree-shakeable
requirements.description: No runtime dependencies; sideEffects false; small bundle.
acceptance: package.json has no dependencies field entries

requirements.title: Typed dual ESM/CJS distribution
requirements.description: Ship ESM and CommonJS builds with .d.ts/.d.cts for every subpath export; supports Node >= 18.
acceptance: Packed package passes ESM and CommonJS consumer tests

requirements.title: 100% test coverage gate
acceptance: npm run coverage passes the 100% threshold

requirements.title: Documented validation scope and data provenance
requirements.description: Data sources and limitations are documented; validators do not claim existence of real entities.
